clues.text: Elkanah of Ephraim had two wives. His other wife had children, but this wife had none.
Each year at the sacrifice in Shiloh, her husband gave her a double portion because he loved her.
Praying at Shiloh, her lips moved but no voice was heard, so Eli the priest thought she was drunk.
At Shiloh she vowed to God that if He gave her a son, no razor would ever touch his head.
Once her boy was weaned, she brought him to Eli at Shiloh along with a three-year-old bull.
After giving her young son to the LORD at Shiloh, she prayed, 'My heart rejoices in the LORD.'
Each year she made a little robe for her son, who served before the LORD, and brought it to him.
